step1_analysis.description: A replica bias circuit used to generate a reference voltage for a hybrid folded current sense amplifier in a DRAM. It uses a diode-connected inverter structure with additional parallel and cross-coupled transistors to match the sense amplifier's characteristics and track process/voltage/temperature variations.

paper_reference.title: A 1.8-V 128-Mb Mobile DRAM With Double Boosting Pump, Hybrid Current Sense Amplifier, and Dual-Referenced Adjustment Scheme for Temperature Sensor

V_OUTB_disabled.description: DC voltage at OUTB when the circuit is disabled (EN=0V)

sky130_expected.calculation: When EN=0, the tail NMOS (XM3) is OFF. OUTB is pulled up by the diode-connected PMOS (XM4) to VDD - |Vth_p|. VDD = 1.8V, |Vth_p| = 0.42V. Expected voltage is 1.8 - 0.42 = 1.38V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the threshold voltage of the PMOS device in SKY130.

V_OUTB_enabled.description: DC bias voltage at OUTB when the circuit is enabled (EN=1.8V)

sky130_expected.calculation: When EN=1.8V, NMOS pull-downs (XM1, XM6) fight PMOS pull-ups (XM4, XM2). XM1 has its gate tied to VDD (1.8V), making it a very strong pull-down in linear region. PMOS devices are in saturation. Balancing currents (I_nmos ~ I_pmos) results in OUTB being pulled close to GND.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The strong NMOS with gate at VDD dominates the diode-connected PMOS, pulling the output low to serve as an NMOS current sink bias.

Power_enabled.description: Static power consumption when the circuit is enabled

sky130_expected.calculation: At V_OUTB = 0.15V, XM4 current is 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (1.8 - 0.15 - 0.42)^2 = ~380uA. Total current from VDD is roughly 400uA. Power = 1.8V * 400uA = 0.72mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 standard transistor current equations for the given W/L ratios.

t_delay_fall.description: Delay from EN rising to OUTB falling to 0.8V

sky130_expected.calculation: Discharging the parasitic capacitance at OUTB (~10-20fF) with ~400uA of net pull-down current. I = C * dV/dt -> dt = 20fF * 0.6V / 400uA = 30ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast internal node discharge limited only by intrinsic device capacitances.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC bias states (enabled/disabled), static power consumption, and transient turn-on delay of the replica inverter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Replica Inverter Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 OUTB VDD N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUTB OUTB INB VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 EN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUTB OUTB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 OUTB OUTB N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM10 OUTB OUT INB VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VINB INB 0 0.9
VOUT OUT 0 0.9
VEN EN 0 pwl(0 0 1n 0 1.1n 1.8 10n 1.8)

.control
  * DC Analysis for bias voltages and power
  dc VEN 0 1.8 1.8
  meas dc v_outb_dis find v(OUTB) at=0
  meas dc v_outb_en find v(OUTB) at=1.8
  meas dc i_vdd_en find i(VVDD) at=1.8
  let power_en = -i_vdd_en * 1.8
  print v_outb_dis v_outb_en power_en

  * Transient Analysis for turn-on delay
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(EN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUTB) val=0.8 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
